title: The geometric convergence of a parallel domain decomposition method on manifolds
summary: This paper establishes a convergence theory for a continuous domain decomposition method for elliptic equations on manifolds. This method originated in \cite{lions2} in the setting of Euclidean domains and was later adapted and generalized to manifolds by \cite{qin_wang_wang}. Although its convergence was known, whether the convergence is geometric has remained open. We prove its geometric convergence and provide various estimates on the convergence rate.
